subject: *: Support building FULLTEXT index (#60720)
summary: Reviewed this merge commit relative to its first parent, limited to parser/planner/expression/executor changes. The patch adds FULLTEXT grammar/AST, rewrites FULLTEXT index definitions into COLUMNAR index form during preprocessing (with parser-name validation and single-column restriction), introduces the `fts_match_word` builtin with TiFlash pushdown wiring (and explicit TiDB-side execution rejection), and updates `SHOW CREATE TABLE` to print FULLTEXT indexes with `WITH PARSER`. Scanned later history up to `upstream/master` for these touched areas; no subsequent commits appeared to be targeted fixes for correctness/semantics regressions in this change.
